items.title: Colgate Palmolive (CL) Stock May Be 21% Below Fair Value Today
items.summary: Colgate-Palmolive has treated shareholders to solid gains in recent years, and that raises a simple but important question for anyone looking at the stock today. Do the cash flows the business can generate over time really line up with the current share price, or has sentiment moved ahead of the underlying economics? Over the past 5 years the stock has returned 45.4%, which puts real weight on whether those gains are grounded in cash flows that can support the present valuation. The...

items.title: Celsius vs. Colgate-Palmolive: Which Consumer Goods Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: Celsius's hyper-growth and Pepsi partnership square off against Colgate-Palmolive's steady cash flow and defensive brands, and the answer depends on how much risk you can handle.

items.title: US energy rig count drops for first time in six weeks

items.title: European shares muted but post best week since June
